defects.claim_says: EO 11808 (1974-09-30) adds the Assistant to the President for Economic Affairs as Deputy Chairman, and 1(b) continues so amended. The claim names no later act affecting that insertion.
defects.source_says: Held EO 11975 (1977-03-07, 42 FR 13267) section 1 reads 'Executive Order No. 11808, as amended, is hereby revoked.' The held 1989 OFR Codification of EO 11269 prints section 1(b) without the Assistant to the President for Economic Affairs, and its note says 'Sec. 1 amended by EO 12164 ... EO 12188' with no EO 11808. The held U.S. Code note (22 U.S.C. 286b note) still prints the Deputy Chairman. The claim addresses neither EO 11975 nor this conflict between the held editorial sources about the text of 1(b).
The stated effective date is 1966-01-01 (section 6). The judgment reasons rest the end on the signing date, 1966-02-14, so the mechanism label contradicts both the date given and the reasons (minor).

defects.claim_says: 'A search of the held Federal Register texts for the number 12163 after 1984 found thirteen later orders; only those named in the clauses delete, restate or replace words in the target subsections.'
defects.source_says: Held EO 12608 section 30 (1987) amends section 1-201(a) 'by revoking paragraphs (23) and (24), and by renumbering paragraphs (25), (26), (27), and (28)'. These are the same paragraph numbers EO 12458 created. Held EO 12738 section 3 (1990) redesignates paragraphs (9) through (31) of 1-201(a), and held EO 12639 rewrites paragraphs (22) and (26). None is named in the clauses. The claim's 1999 end for paragraph (24) rests on tracking that paragraph through renumbering, but the claim never addresses EO 12608's revocation of a paragraph numbered (24) in the same subsection. On this reviewer's reading the 1987 revocation reached EO 12560's new paragraphs, not EO 12458's, so the outcome may stand. The statement about the search is still false, and the identification is not reasoned against the intervening deletions.

defects.claim_says: 'subsections (a) and (c) of section 2 and subsections (b) and (c) of section 3'; EO 13118 section 3 'ended section 2(c) of EO 12458'
defects.source_says: EO 12458's section 2 has subsections (a) and (b), and its section 3 has (a) and (b). There is no section 2(c) of EO 12458. The clause judgment_reasons correctly say 'subsection (b) of section 2' and 'section 3(a) and (b)', so the rationale is internally inconsistent with the clauses.
